posts.mainText: OSCE PA Special Representative Federica Onori visited Copenhagen on April 28, engaging University of Copenhagen on AI governance challenges, ethical frameworks, regulatory approaches, and human rights.
posts.replyText: Fosters institutional coordination between international bodies and academia, promoting legitimacy through inclusive dialogue for accountable, human-centric AI policies.

posts.mainText: South Africa withdrew its draft national AI policy last week after AI-generated fake citations were found. It proposed a National AI Commission and Ethics Board to lead continental innovation.
posts.replyText: Exposes legitimacy risks in AI-assisted policymaking, highlighting need for verification protocols to ensure credible institutional coordination and policy integrity.

posts.mainText: Credo AI joined Coalition for Health AI (CHAI) Partner Program, integrating its governance platform with CHAI's framework. CHAI unites 3,000+ members for trusted, safe health AI deployment.
posts.replyText: Strengthens cross-organization AI safety efforts in healthcare via standardized tools, workflows, and compliance amid rising regulations.
